note: THREE HOMONYM PAIRS LIVE IN THIS WORKSPACE AND ONE OF THEM PRODUCED A WRONG NUMBER I NEARLY ACTED ON. Found during The Axes (merged ff8eec1d). (1) Formation is BOTH domains/climate/src/facets.rs communities (Tundra, Reef, KarstCave) AND astronomy::moons::Formation (GiantImpact, Capture). (2) Substrate is BOTH windows/worldgen/src/lib.rs line 2192 (temperature_c, moisture, insolation, height_asl_m — what tolerance_liebig scores) AND domains/alchemy/src/lib.rs line 34 (metallic, organic, saline, refractory, purity). (3) The legacy Biome name strings disagree with Formation kebab-case on two of the fifteen names the affinity registry uses: coral-reef against reef, and epipelagic, which is not a community at all but a stratum wearing a formation coat. THE DAMAGE: a scan for domain-to-domain vocabulary crossings returned FOUR, and I was one step from building an architecture argument on it. Reading the actual hits: two were doc comments, one was the astronomy homonym, and exactly ONE was a real crossing (CaveKind mirrored into climate per decision 0094). The corrected figure changed the recommendation from a program to one cheap narrow change. RULE: in this workspace a bare type name is not a unique referent. Grep the fully qualified path or the observable the code produces, and read every hit before you count it. The reconciliation for case 3 is committed in windows/worldgen/tests/axis_geometry.rs as RECONCILE, with a guard that reddens if a rated biome stops resolving.
